messages:
julian: Quick postmortem follow-up: we traced last night's low-aggregation spike to the ETL watermarking change that started emitting in ms instead of s. ~55% of late spans were dropped. Need owners and mitigation plan.

mira: Oof. Do we have a clear repro window?

julian: Yep. Root cause: CONFIG_WATERMARK_UNIT env var parsed but never normalized, new deploy set value to 5000 thinking it was s. Affected window ~2026-03-20T22:40Z -> 2026-03-21T03:10Z.

oliver: I'll take the remediation backfill. Need to coordinate with analytics for snapshotting. ETA: prep tomorrow morning, run overnight. JIRA: OBS-4992.

tara: I'll own the alerts + postmortem updates. Adding a rule: aggregate_latency_bucket_shift > 30s OR spans_ingested_drop > 20% over 5m.

mira: I'll add a CI gate: parse config units at startup and fail fast if ambiguous. Also add unit tests for env parsing.

ops-bot: Auto-note: scheduled maintenance window requested for backfill - please confirm.

julian: Can we add a small regression that replays ~10 late messages with timestamp skew to validate bucketing?

oliver: Yes, will include replay in OBS-4992 with a dry-run flag. Will snapshot aggregates before applying.

julian: Action items:
- oliver: backfill plan, snapshot + dry-run, run night-of (OBS-4992) 
- tara: dashboards + alert rules + postmortem owner updates 
- mira: config parse self-check + unit tests 
- julian: coordinate analytics snapshot & rollback plan 
- oncall: monitor "aggregate_latency_bucket_shift" during rollout

tara: I'll add owners and mark Tara as escalation contact in the doc. Sync scheduled Mon 09:00 UTC.

mira: Also adding a linter to the infra-config repo to catch unit-mismatches for known keys.

julian: Thanks. If anyone misses an ETA, call it out here so we can reassign. :pray:

oliver: Filed OBS-4992 and linked the backfill playbook.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 5 days (Mon 09:00 UTC).

tara: Updated postmortem with owners and timelines, linking PRs. Will mark as resolved after backfill and monitoring window passes.
